_comment: Third-party skills ACE ships. On first launch after an install or update, SkillSetupService git-clones each repo below so its author gets clone traffic and a credit line in THIRD_PARTY_SKILLS.md. subdir: path inside the repo holding the skill files (SKILL.md etc.); null means the repo has no SKILL.md of its own and ACE's bundled copy is kept, the clone being for attribution only.
